description: A Java class implementing a PredicateVisitor to evaluate whether 'Thing' objects match a given filter, using various predicate operations such as equals, not equals, greater than, less than, etc.

classes.name: ThingPredicatePredicateVisitor
classes.description: A singleton class implementing PredicateVisitor for evaluating predicates on 'Thing' objects based on JSON fields.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the visitor.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a Predicate<Thing> from a given predicate and field name.

methods.name: visitEq
methods.description: Generates a predicate function for equality comparison.

methods.name: visitNe
methods.description: Generates a predicate function for inequality comparison.

methods.name: visitGe
methods.description: Generates a predicate function for greater than or equal comparison.

methods.name: visitGt
methods.description: Generates a predicate function for strictly greater than comparison.

methods.name: visitLe
methods.description: Generates a predicate function for less than or equal comparison.

methods.name: visitLt
methods.description: Generates a predicate function for strictly less than comparison.

methods.name: visitIn
methods.description: Generates a predicate function for checking membership in a list.

methods.name: visitLike
methods.description: Generates a predicate function for pattern matching using regex.
